description: The C# runtime of the BDD suite format: lint, run and list YAML suites, the session a test framework drives, reports, the embedded core actions, and the extension API through which a consumer adds its own actions and builds its own suiterun.

Runs BDD YAML suites as MSTest 4, NUnit 4 or xUnit v3 tests: every build generates one test class per suite and one test per case from bddsuite.tests.yaml, so dotnet test, its filters and an IDE's test explorer work on them.

Unofficial fork of DotNetCore.GaussDB with a fix for GaussDB/openGauss SHA256 (RFC5802) authentication, so password_encryption_type=2 works without falling back to md5. GaussDB is the open source .NET data provider for PostgreSQL.
Unofficial fork of DotNetCore.EntityFrameworkCore.GaussDB, built against the forked driver that fixes GaussDB SHA256 (RFC5802) authentication. PostgreSQL/GaussDB provider for Entity Framework Core.
YubiOn FIDO2Server Service SDK for .NET. Easily integrate FIDO2 / WebAuthn passkey authentication into .NET applications.

Build tools for Seneschal, the local developer toolbelt. Gives an extension its types (IToolModule, ToolMetadata, IToolMcp) and the build rules that stage it and pack it as a .snx file to import in the Extension Manager.
